outcome: `FailFast` can be used as a dictionary key and in sets, like the other metadata classes

acceptance_criteria.text: A `FailFast` instance can be placed in a set and used as a dictionary key.

expected_verification.assertion: constructing a FailFast and adding it to a set succeeds

acceptance_criteria.text: Two `FailFast` instances configured the same way are interchangeable as keys.

expected_verification.assertion: two FailFast instances with equal fail_fast values map to the same dictionary entry
